description: Manage Workspaces — the top-level containers in LIFE (Workspace → Project → To-do). A Workspace is what used to be called a Focus (mind_focuses stays as an alias); a Workspace can also be shared with teammates or a client, and it is the unit the Astra AI client portal syncs with. Use list to see the workspaces you belong to, create/update/delete to maintain them (delete soft-archives), and members/add_member/remove_member to control who can see it (add_member needs the person's MIND username). Pass the returned workspace_id to mind_projects and mind_todos. Reach for mind_projects for the projects inside a workspace and mind_todos for the to-dos inside a project.

action.description: list/get/create/update/delete workspaces (delete = soft archive), members (list who has access), add_member / remove_member (share or unshare)

color.description: Color stripe (default, red, orange, yellow, green, blue, purple, pink)

include_archived.description: On list — true to include archived workspaces

member_id.description: Member id or username to remove (remove_member)

role.description: Member role for add_member: member (default), admin, viewer

workspace_id.description: Workspace id — required for every action except list and create

name: mind_workspaces
